incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: eval-quality-regression (P1) — safety gate trip + output-drift detected for model redwood/gemini-lite-v3 on hosted-api. Automatic paging enabled. See eval pipeline: failing safety checks > 5% over 5m window.

pagerduty: page created for oncall: Leila

leila (oncall): I got the PD page, acking. jumping in. can someone paste quick impact summary?

jess (sre): ack from me too. alert shows eval-runner reported "safety_regression: true" + tox score spike across prompt-set 'customer-chat-flow-2026'. affects 2 production routes with ~1.8k req/min combined. error budgets not burned yet but infra fallback isn't automatic for this class.

ashwin (eng-ml): confirmed — nightly eval job 03:40 UTC flagged output drift: profanity/safety filter failure rate went from 0.2% -> 6.1% after model variant deploy (v3-quant). We have matching regressions in unit evals for prompt set 'sales-chat'.

marco (product): any direct customer failures? which customers hit this in production?

olga (customer-success): two customers on Dedicated (acme-fin, shoplifyx) reported increased complaints this morning; logs show model completions truncated/unsafe content in ~0.03% of requests — small but unacceptable for both. I'm drafting a heads-up.

leila (oncall): immediate next steps per runbook: 1) stop traffic to affected model 2) enable fallback routing 3) mute noisy alerts for this signature 4) gather a quick triage doc. Who can flip routing?

ryan (eng-runtime): I can flip it. Plan: route traffic from redwood/gemini-lite-v3 -> redwood/gemini-lite-v2-fallback, apply a gradual 100% switch. Doing via admin API now.

ryan (eng-runtime): ```bash
# switch routing (admin token required)
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/switch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"from_model":"redwood/gemini-lite-v3","to_model":"redwood/gemini-lite-v2-fallback","strategy":"immediate"}'
```

leila (oncall): copying runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/eval-regression|eval-regression runbook>. Make sure to note the eval signature id and the failing tests.

ashwin (eng-ml): eval signature id: eval/signatures/2026-03-14-az-09. Failing tests: safety/profanity, hallucination-check-1. I recommend rolling back v3-quant rollout and re-running gated evals.

jess (sre): I see routing change started. console shows 80% switched in 15s, now at 100%. Monitoring latency + error rates.

olga (customer-success): will send templated message to affected customers now: short heads-up + mitigation note. cc product.

marco (product): good. we'll offer dedicated support slot for acme-fin and shoplifyx. log their request IDs in the incident ticket.

leila (oncall): muting duplicate PagerDuty pages for this eval-signature for 30m to avoid noise. leaving a note to unmute after triage.

incident-bot: note added to incident tracker: routing flipped -> fallback model, customers notified, eval signature noted.

ashwin (eng-ml): running a quick revert for the quantized build; full rollback queued to finish in ~6m. also kicking off a retest of the prompt-set locally.

jess (sre): after routing switch: error rates normalized, tox spike rolled back to baseline within 2m. infra metrics look stable. pre- and post-compare attached in incident ticket.

olga (customer-success): messages sent. acme-fin asked for ETA on root cause — gave provisional timeline: 6-12 hours for triage + 24h for RCA.

leila (oncall): keeping this as active incident until we confirm root cause and push a guarded redeploy. Next: ashwin + ryan to produce minimal repro and a safe test harness; jess to monitor; marco/olga to own customer comms.

ashwin (eng-ml): repro created. appears to be prompt-sensitivity to tokenizer edge-case introduced by quantization changes. hypothesis: quantization changed tokenization boundary for some rare sequences, leading to filter bypass. working on a patch to the token-preprocessor and adding regression tests to the eval gate.

ryan (eng-runtime): added temporary guard in routing layer: any eval-gate trip for safety signatures will auto-fall back to v2-fallback for 5m windows until we clear the signature. config snippet I used: ```json
{"auto_fallback_on_eval_failure":true,"signatures":["eval/signatures/2026-03-14-az-09"]}
```

marco (product): good mitigation. we should also add this signature to the permanent watchlist and expand canary checks.

jess (sre): monitoring 30m post-mitigation: no further safety trips, latency within SLO, no error budget burn.

leila (oncall): marking incident status: mitigated -> customer impact contained. Will keep incident live for RCA and follow-up actions. Starting handoff to day oncall at 08:00 UTC.

olga (customer-success): logging the customer follow-ups and scheduling two calls with acme-fin + shoplifyx for 12:00 UTC.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved after routing change and triage confirmation.

leila (oncall): final notes: root cause suspected quantization-tokenizer interaction; short-term mitigation = routing fallback + mute; long-term actions: fix token-preprocessor, add regression tests to eval gates, add signature to watchlist, improve deploy checklist (add quantization tokenization checks). Assigning owners: ashwin (fix + tests), ryan (runtime guard + routing hardening), jess (monitoring + dashboards), marco/olga (customer comms).

marco (product): creating an incident ticket + postmortem doc. will ping for review.

leila (oncall): handing off to day oncall (jess) at 08:00 UTC. if anything spikes, re-open PD page. great work team, :thumbsup:

jess (sre): acked handoff. I'll watch the eval gates for next 12h and update incident ticket with metrics.

olga (customer-success): closing customer messages for now; will update after RCA.

incident-bot: incident thread closed (mitigated) 1799990137.
